# Purdue University Fort Wayne

> Purdue University Fort Wayne is a comprehensive regional campus offering 200+ academic programs, research opportunities, and student life experiences with strong community partnerships.

PFW serves prospective students, current students, faculty, staff, families, alumni, and community members with integrated resources for admissions, academics, research, and campus engagement. The institution emphasizes accessible education, research centers, and regional collaboration.

## Key Topics

- Undergraduate and Graduate Programs
- Admissions and Financial Aid
- Colleges and Schools
- Student Life and Organizations
- Research Centers and Institutes
- Campus Resources
- Academic Calendar and Registration
- ROTC
- Helmke Library
- Career Development
- Community Partnerships
- Mastodons
- Fort Wayne Location
- Student Counseling
- Campus Tours

## Admissions and Academic Programs

- [Admissions and Financial Aid](https://www.pfw.edu/admissions-financial-aid): Admissions, financial aid, FAFSA, and application information for prospective students.
- [Academics and Research](https://www.pfw.edu/academics-research): Overview of academic programs, colleges, and research opportunities at PFW.
- [Majors and Minors](https://www.pfw.edu/academics-research/majors-minors): Searchable directory of undergraduate and graduate degree programs.
- [Colleges and Schools](https://www.pfw.edu/academics-research/colleges-and-schools): Directory of PFW colleges and schools including Business, Engineering, Liberal Arts.
- [Graduate Programs](https://www.pfw.edu/academics-research/graduate-programs): Master's degree programs with flexible schedules and graduate assistantships.
- [Course Information](https://www.pfw.edu/academics-research/course-information): Academic calendars, course catalogs, schedules, and registration information.

## Student Resources and Campus Life

- [Current Student](https://www.pfw.edu/current-students): Hub for current students with resources, events, and campus life information.
- [Mastodon Life](https://www.pfw.edu/mastodon-life): Student life, organizations, events, and campus activities at PFW.
- [Parent or Family Member](https://www.pfw.edu/parent-family-member): Resources and information for parents and family members of PFW students.
- [Faculty or Staff Member](https://www.pfw.edu/faculty-staff): Portal and resources for PFW faculty and staff members.

## Research and Academic Centers

- [Research](https://www.pfw.edu/academics-research/research): Research centers, student research opportunities, and community partnerships.
- [Centers and Institutes](https://www.pfw.edu/academics-research/centers-and-institutes): Research centers including Applied Mathematics, Collaborative Media, and Marine Conservation.

## About Purdue University Fort Wayne

- [About PFW](https://www.pfw.edu/about-pfw): Institutional overview, mission, leadership, and community involvement at PFW.
- [Mission, Vision, Values, and Principles](https://www.pfw.edu/about-pfw/mission-vision-values-principles): PFW's mission, core values, academic freedom, and institutional principles.
- [Office of the Chancellor](https://www.pfw.edu/chancellor): Chancellor's office information and university leadership under Ronald Elsenbaumer.
- [History](https://www.pfw.edu/about-pfw/history): PFW institutional history from 1964 founding through present-day development.

## Community Engagement

- [Community Member](https://www.pfw.edu/community-member): Community engagement, events, and campus facilities information for visitors.
- [PFW Alum](https://www.pfw.edu/pfw-alum): Alumni resources, profiles, and engagement opportunities for PFW graduates.

## University Homepage

- [Purdue University Fort Wayne](https://www.pfw.edu): Purdue Fort Wayne homepage with 200+ academic programs, admissions, and campus information.
